output.reasoning: Role type: This is an IT Support Engineer role on the IT Operations team. The work is triaging hardware, software, networking, and account issues, supporting macOS/ChromeOS/iOS/Android endpoints, administering Google Workspace and Slack, MDM and identity/access management, AV and conference room support, and an on-call rotation. It is not hands-on ML, NLP, or AI systems engineering, and it matches none of Ananya's target roles (Machine Learning Engineer, AI Engineer, Applied NLP Engineer, ML Engineer, Research Engineer). The mentions of automating work 'including with Claude' and using AI tools for productivity do not make it an ML engineering role. Location: The posting is based in Dublin, IE, with salary in EUR and a hybrid policy of at least 25% in-office. It is neither US-based nor designated Remote, so it fails the location criterion even though she is willing to relocate within the US. Skills: The minimum qualifications name several specific technologies (macOS, ChromeOS, iOS, Android, Google Workspace, Slack, Bash or Python, SSO/MFA/directory services, MDM). Only Python overlaps with her shipped list, so it also fails the 2-technology skills test. Level: No explicit years of experience, seniority title, or PhD is required, so level is not disqualifying. Sponsorship: The posting says 'We do sponsor visas!', so sponsorship is not disqualifying. The role-type, location, and skills failures each independently make this NOT_RELEVANT.
